bio.text: Don Bacon was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives in 2016 and represents Nebraska's 2nd Congressional District.
He served nearly 30 years on active duty in the U.S. Air Force beginning in 1985, retiring as a brigadier general, with a career focused on electronic warfare and intelligence.
He grew up on a family farm in Illinois and graduated from Northern Illinois University in 1984 with a B.A. in political science.
He serves on the House Armed Services Committee and the House Committee on Agriculture.
